verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own manual says SSH keys can be stored on the Secure Enclave and protected by Face ID or Touch ID, so SSH remote connections are guarded by biometrics. The documentation is a single sentence and covers SSH keys only. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the biometric prompt flow and setup, evidence for HTTPS credentials or tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my remote connections with biometric authentication like Face ID or fingerprint

citations.quote: For extra security SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.
You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.
